completionSettings.completionHelp: What happens when an unpaid order is ready to hand over.
completionSettings.pressesOneHelp: Best if you take the money as you hand over the food. You get a single button, “Mark paid and collected”; it records the payment and completes the order at the same time.
completionSettings.pressesTwoHelp: Best if payment and handover happen at different times — someone pays at the food truck, then comes and collects when the food is ready. You get two buttons: first “Mark as paid”, then “Collected” when they take the food.
